[FMLA 18] IdealGas — Ideal Gas Law

State equation; uses gas constant R from ROM.

Calculator scroll name: IdealGas. State equation; uses gas constant R from ROM.

formula
PV=nRT

Four numbers describe the trapped gas: pressure, volume, amount, temperature. Fix three and the fourth is determined. R is the gas constant from CONST.

keys
FMLA→1→8

Primary inputs: n, T, V.

steps

How to run

  1. Press FMLA, then 1, then 8 (or scroll to the name and EXE)
  2. Enter each prompted value
  3. Read the result

Example

  1. FMLA → 1 → 8
  2. Enter n, T, V
  3. Uses R from constants
note

Uses the molar gas constant R from ROM (CONST 7-3). Enter n in mol, T in K, V in m³ (all > 0); the result P is in Pa (N/m²).
